verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for an identity-verification platform, which could publish its SDKs or core under an open license, so the axis applies. The evidence covers SDKs, APIs, webhooks, and no-code workflow tools, but nothing says any source code is published or under what license. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
